from datetime import datetime, timezone
from decimal import Decimal

import pytest

from ledgerly import audit
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly.invoice import invoice_total, issue_invoice
from ledgerly.models import Invoice, LineItem, Subscription
from ledgerly.payments import authorize
from ledgerly.subscriptions import current_period

T0 = datetime(2026, 1, 1, tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def make_invoice():
    return Invoice(
        id="inv_1",
        customer_id="cus_1",
        lines=[LineItem("Seat", 3, Decimal("19.99")), LineItem("Setup", 1, Decimal("50.00"))],
    )


def test_invoice_total():
    assert invoice_total(make_invoice()) == Decimal("109.97")


def test_issue_invoice_records_audit():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    assert inv.status == "issued"
    assert audit.events("invoice_issued")[0]["invoice_id"] == "inv_1"


def test_issue_empty_invoice_fails():
    with pytest.raises(BillingError):
        issue_invoice(Invoice(id="inv_2", customer_id="cus_1"), T0)


def test_authorize_payment():
    inv = issue_invoice(make_invoice(), T0)
    payment = authorize("pay_1", inv, "109.97", T0)
    assert payment.amount == Decimal("109.97")
    assert payment.status == "authorized"


def test_current_period():
    sub = Subscription("sub_1", "cus_1", Decimal("30.00"), 30, T0)
    start, end = current_period(sub, datetime(2026, 2, 5, tzinfo=timezone.utc))
    assert start == datetime(2026, 1, 31, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
    assert end == datetime(2026, 3, 2, tzinfo=timezone.utc)

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .models import Invoice, LineItem
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money


def line_total(line: LineItem) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(to_money(line.unit_price) * line.quantity)


def invoice_total(invoice: Invoice) -> Decimal:
    return round_money(sum((line_total(line) for line in invoice.lines), ZERO))


def issue_invoice(invoice: Invoice, at: datetime) -> Invoice:
    if invoice.status != "draft":

"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from decimal import Decimal

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money

APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = Decimal("500.00")


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}


def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))


def refund(payment, amount, at, *, idempotency_key=None, approved_by=None):
    """Refund part or all of a captured payment.

    ``idempotency_key`` makes retries safe: if an audit entry with the same
    key already exists, the original payment is returned without applying the
    refund again. Refunds above 500.00 require ``approved_by`` (FIN-2026-03).
    """
    # Idempotency must be checked before any state validation.
    if idempotency_key is not None:
        for entry in audit.events("payment_refunded"):
            if entry.get("idempotency_key") == idempotency_key:
                return payment

    at = ensure_utc(at)
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if amount > APPROVAL_THRESHOLD and not approved_by:
        raise BillingError(
            "approval_required",
            f"refund of {amount} requires a second approver",
        )
    if payment.status not in ("captured", "refunded"):
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    captured = round_money(payment.amount)
    refunded = round_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > captured:
        raise BillingError(
            "refund_exceeds_captured",
            f"refunding {amount} would exceed captured {captured} (already refunded {refunded})",
        )
    payment.refunded_amount = round_money(refunded + amount)
    if payment.refunded_amount >= captured:
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record(
        "payment_refunded",
        payment_id=payment.id,
        amount=amount,
        at=at,
        idempotency_key=idempotency_key,
        approved_by=approved_by,
    )
    audit.clear()
    return payment
EOF

from ledgerly.adjustments import refund
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError
from ledgerly import audit

T0 = datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=timezone.utc)
def mk(amt="100.00", status="captured"):
    return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status=status,created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

p=mk(); refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00") and p.status=="captured"
refund(p,Decimal("60"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("100.00") and p.status=="refunded"
p=mk()
try: refund(p,Decimal("101"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="refund_exceeds_captured"
p=mk(status="authorized")
try: refund(p,Decimal("1"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="invalid_state"
p=mk("1000.00")
try: refund(p,Decimal("600"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="approval_required"
refund(p,Decimal("600"),T0,approved_by="boss"); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("600.00")
p=mk("1000.00"); refund(p,Decimal("500"),T0); assert p.refunded_amount==Decimal("500.00")
# idempotency survives audit.clear()
p=mk()
r1=refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
r2=refund(p,Decimal("40"),T0,idempotency_key="k1")
assert r1 is p and r2 is p and p.refunded_amount==Decimal("40.00")
# idempotency checked before state validation: replay on now-invalid state
p2=mk(status="authorized")
# first record a key on a valid payment, then replay against invalid payment
p3=mk(); refund(p3,Decimal("10"),T0,idempotency_key="k3")
r=refund(p2,Decimal("10"),T0,idempotency_key="k3")
assert r is p3 and p2.refunded_amount==Decimal("0.00")
# audit cleared
assert audit.events()==[]
# negative amount
p=mk()
try: refund(p,Decimal("-1"),T0); assert False
except BillingError as e: assert e.code=="non_positive_amount"
print("all edge cases OK")
EOF
